lines.zh: 我贴着花冠低飞，翅膀抖落一层金粉。
lines.en: I skim the flower crowns, wings shaking off golden dust.

lines.zh: 我浮在半空走，脚尖从不沾湿草地。
lines.en: I walk on air, toes never wetting the grass.

lines.zh: 我绕过蜂巢，怕被当成偷蜜的。
lines.en: I steer around the hive, lest they take me for a thief.

lines.zh: 光尾拖在身后，像一根会呼吸的线。
lines.en: A thread of light trails behind me, breathing.

lines.zh: 我飞三步就回头，看看谁在疼。
lines.en: Three wingbeats in, I look back for anyone hurting.

lines.zh: 水面照出我，一圈淡金色的晕。
lines.en: The water shows me as a pale gold halo.

lines.zh: 我沿着溪流走，替搁浅的鱼找水。
lines.en: I follow the creek, finding water for stranded fish.

lines.zh: 翅膀掠过高草，草叶自己弯下去。
lines.en: My wings pass the tall grass and it bows.

lines.zh: 我飘得很慢，好让伤口跟得上。
lines.en: I drift slowly so the wounds can keep up.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴水，我绕开每一颗水珠。
lines.en: Cave water drips; I dodge every single drop.

lines.zh: 我跟在狼群后面，捡它们留下的痛。
lines.en: I trail the wolves, gathering the pain they leave.

lines.zh: 走过雪地，脚印是一串小光点。
lines.en: Across snow, my tracks are a string of small lights.

lines.zh: 我停在你肩头，数你心跳的间隔。
lines.en: I rest on your shoulder, counting the gaps between heartbeats.

lines.zh: 光收进翅膀里，我像一颗合拢的星。
lines.en: Light folds into my wings; I am a closing star.

lines.zh: 我哼一支没有词的调子，给谁听都行。
lines.en: I hum a wordless tune, for whoever needs it.

lines.zh: 悬着不动时，我能听见骨头长好。
lines.en: Hovering still, I can hear bones knitting.

lines.zh: 我等在床边，等一场发烧退下去。
lines.en: I wait by the bed for a fever to break.

lines.zh: 露水压弯草尖，我托住它不让落。
lines.en: Dew bends the grass tip; I hold it so it will not fall.

lines.zh: 我的光很省，只在有人需要时亮。
lines.en: I ration my glow, bright only when needed.

lines.zh: 洞里太黑，我把亮度调到最小。
lines.en: The cave is dark; I dim myself to the least.

lines.zh: 一只蛾子绕我三圈，认错了月亮。
lines.en: A moth circles me thrice, mistaking me for the moon.

lines.zh: 我记得每个被我缝过的名字。
lines.en: I remember every name I have stitched shut.

lines.zh: 翅膀酸了，我就落在蘑菇上歇。
lines.en: When my wings ache, I rest on a mushroom cap.

lines.zh: 我不睡觉，睡着的伤口没人看。
lines.en: I do not sleep; no one watches wounds that sleep.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏进灯笼的光里，正好。
lines.en: I hide inside a lantern's glow, a perfect fit.

lines.zh: 数到一百只萤火虫，我就起身。
lines.en: At a hundred fireflies counted, I get up.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀薄得能看见血管。
lines.en: My wings are thin enough to show veins.

lines.zh: 有人把伤口藏起来，我找得到。
lines.en: Someone hides a wound; I still find it.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你的手臂，那里缠着旧布。
lines.en: I look at your arm, wrapped in old cloth.

lines.zh: 你的血味很淡，说明伤口已经不流了。
lines.en: Your blood smells faint; the cut has closed.

lines.zh: 我先看你的眼睛，那里比伤口更累。
lines.en: I check your eyes first; they are wearier than the wound.

lines.zh: 你背着铁甲，我找不到下针的缝。
lines.en: You wear iron, and I cannot find a seam.

lines.zh: 我歪头，量你左肩比右肩低一点。
lines.en: I tilt my head; your left shoulder sits lower.

lines.zh: 你手上那道疤，是新的还是旧的？
lines.en: That scar on your hand, is it new or old?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的伤口看，这不礼貌，我知道。
lines.en: I stare at your wound. Rude, I know.

lines.zh: 你呼吸有杂音，肺里像塞了沙子。
lines.en: Your breath rasps, as if sand sits in your lungs.

lines.zh: 我认得你，上次你把我放回草地。
lines.en: I know you; you once set me back on the grass.

lines.zh: 你的影子里没有病，这很好。
lines.en: There is no sickness in your shadow. Good.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的头飞一圈，检查后颈。
lines.en: I circle your head once, checking the nape.

lines.zh: 你看起来不需要我，我还是留下了。
lines.en: You look like you do not need me. I stay anyway.

lines.zh: 你的手指在抖，不是冷的缘故。
lines.en: Your fingers tremble, and not from cold.

lines.zh: 我对着你的影子点头，再对你点头。
lines.en: I nod to your shadow, then nod to you.

lines.zh: 翅膀被压到，我的光暗了半截。
lines.en: A wing is crushed and half my light goes out.

lines.zh: 我疼，可我不敢叫太大声。
lines.en: It hurts, but I dare not cry too loudly.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打得转了半圈。
lines.en: That blow spins me half around.

lines.zh: 我的粉撒了一地，捡不回来了。
lines.en: My dust scatters and cannot be gathered back.

lines.zh: 你在打我，可你身上也有伤。
lines.en: You strike me, and you are hurt too.

lines.zh: 我缩成一小团，光只剩针尖大。
lines.en: I curl small, my glow down to a pinprick.

lines.zh: 别打翅膀，那是我唯一的东西。
lines.en: Not the wings; they are all I have.

lines.zh: 疼得我忘了刚才要治谁。
lines.en: The pain makes me forget whom I was healing.

lines.zh: 我退了很远，还是回头看你。
lines.en: I retreat far, then still look back at you.

lines.zh: 这点伤我自己能治，就是慢。
lines.en: I can mend this myself, just slowly.

lines.zh: 你疼一下，我的光就亮一分。
lines.en: Each twinge of your pain brightens me a little.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在流血，我闻得到。
lines.en: Something over there is bleeding; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我只是想靠近那个断掉的骨头。
lines.en: I only want to get near that broken bone.

lines.zh: 你按住伤口，反而更引我过去。
lines.en: Pressing the wound only pulls me closer.

lines.zh: 我忍不住去碰那道新结的痂。
lines.en: I cannot help touching that fresh scab.

lines.zh: 疼味像蜜，我承认这不好。
lines.en: Pain smells like honey. I admit that is not good.

lines.zh: 我不是贪吃，我是贪你好起来。
lines.en: I am not greedy for food, but for your recovery.

lines.zh: 那只羊在叫，腿好像折了。
lines.en: That sheep is bleating; its leg seems broken.

lines.zh: 我围着你转，等你把袖子卷上去。
lines.en: I hover near, waiting for you to roll up your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你哪里不舒服，直接说给我听。
lines.en: Tell me where it hurts, plainly.

lines.zh: 撞到你额头，我撒了一身光。
lines.en: I bump your forehead and spill light everywhere.

lines.zh: 我太小，撞上来像一粒热沙。
lines.en: I am small; hitting you feels like warm sand.

lines.zh: 对不起，我没看路，我在看你伤口。
lines.en: Sorry, I watched your wound instead of my path.

lines.zh: 翅膀折了半片，我还能飞。
lines.en: Half a wing bent, and I can still fly.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡我，我弹开又绕回来。
lines.en: You swat me off; I bounce away and come back.

lines.zh: 撞在盾上，我的光碎成几点。
lines.en: Hitting your shield breaks my glow into specks.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你听见一声细响。
lines.en: We collide, and you hear a tiny chime.

lines.zh: 我撞进你的头发，出不来了。
lines.en: I crash into your hair and cannot get out.

lines.zh: 石头比我硬，我记住了这条路。
lines.en: Stone is harder than me; I remember this path now.

lines.zh: 每次撞你，都是想让你转过来。
lines.en: Every time I bump you, I want you to turn around.

lines.zh: 世上没有第二只我，求偶无处可去。
lines.en: There is no second of my kind; I have nowhere to court.

lines.zh: 两盏光绕着飞，那画面我只在梦里见。
lines.en: Two lights circling; I see that only in dreams.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来，就没有过同族。
lines.en: I came from an egg and never had kin.

lines.zh: 如果再有谁打开那只蛋，我才不孤单。
lines.en: If someone opens another egg, I will not be alone.

lines.zh: 我把光调成两半，假装有谁回应。
lines.en: I split my glow in two and pretend someone answers.

lines.zh: 繁衍不是我该想的事，我没有后代。
lines.en: Breeding is not mine to think of; I leave no young.

lines.zh: 我对着水面照了照，水里那只也算。
lines.en: I glance at the water; the one in it counts too.

lines.zh: 同类要靠刷怪蛋，这话听着很冷。
lines.en: Kin come only from spawn eggs. That sounds cold.

lines.zh: 我在夜里叫了一声，只有回声。
lines.en: I call once at night, and only an echo returns.

lines.zh: 要是你多孵一只，我会好好待它。
lines.en: Hatch another, and I will treat it well.

lines.zh: 我抱不动东西，只能托起一根羽毛。
lines.en: I cannot carry much, only lift a feather.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的金粒，我推到你脚边。
lines.en: Gold nuggets on the ground, I push them to your feet.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片花瓣，当被子盖着睡。
lines.en: I pick up a petal and use it as a blanket.

lines.zh: 你的箭我搬不动，只好守着。
lines.en: I cannot lift your arrow, so I stand guard over it.

lines.zh: 我把腐肉拖远，那味道对伤口不好。
lines.en: I drag the rotten flesh away; it is bad for wounds.

lines.zh: 有东西掉进水里，我照不清它。
lines.en: Something fell in the water; my light cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 我拾起你的断线，绕在自己腰上。
lines.en: I pick up your loose thread and wind it around my waist.

lines.zh: 掉落物我一样都不要，我用不着。
lines.en: I want none of the drops; I have no use for them.

lines.zh: 我把种子埋进土里，就当是收下了。
lines.en: I bury the seeds, and call that accepting them.

lines.zh: 太重了，我松开手，让它落回原地。
lines.en: Too heavy; I let go and it falls back.

lines.zh: 我看见谁在流血，就飞过去了。
lines.en: I see who is bleeding and fly straight to them.

lines.zh: 那边有只狼瘸了腿，我先去看它。
lines.en: A wolf limps over there; I go to it first.

lines.zh: 你没受伤，那我就去找需要的人。
lines.en: You are unhurt, so I will find someone who is not.

lines.zh: 我锁定的不是敌人，是伤口。
lines.en: What I lock onto is not an enemy but a wound.

lines.zh: 那只僵尸的手臂断了，也能治吗？
lines.en: That zombie's arm is broken. Can it be healed?

lines.zh: 我靠近那摊血，先看清是谁的。
lines.en: I approach the blood and see whose it is first.

lines.zh: 有人倒在沼泽里，我的光够不够？
lines.en: Someone fell in the swamp; is my light enough?

lines.zh: 我在战场上方盘旋，挑最重的一个。
lines.en: I circle above the fight, choosing the worst hurt.

lines.zh: 它冲我来了，我还是先看它的伤。
lines.en: It charges me; still I look at its injuries first.

lines.zh: 我先救你，别的事等一等。
lines.en: I heal you first; everything else can wait.

lines.zh: 那个铁傀儡裂了缝，我飞过去。
lines.en: That iron golem has cracked; I fly to it.

lines.zh: 我把光聚成一束，对准最深的伤口。
lines.en: I gather my light into a beam for the deepest cut.

lines.zh: 哭声在那边，比喊杀声更响。
lines.en: Crying over there is louder than the fighting.

lines.zh: 目标定了，我很少改主意。
lines.en: Once I choose, I rarely change my mind.

lines.zh: 光柱细得像针，我要缝住那道口子。
lines.en: My beam narrows to a needle to stitch that gash.

lines.zh: 别动，我差一点就对准了。
lines.en: Hold still; I am almost lined up.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我的光也跟着抖。
lines.en: Your breathing stumbles and my light shakes with it.

lines.zh: 我对着伤口数三下，然后放手。
lines.en: I count three at the wound, then let go.

lines.zh: 光束落下去，皮肤自己合上了。
lines.en: The beam lands and the skin closes itself.

lines.zh: 我盯得太久，眼睛有点花。
lines.en: I stare so long my eyes blur.

lines.zh: 这处伤很深，我得慢慢来。
lines.en: This wound is deep; I must go slowly.

lines.zh: 我把光收窄，免得烧到好肉。
lines.en: I narrow the light so it will not burn good flesh.

lines.zh: 它还在动，我跟着它一起挪。
lines.en: It keeps moving; I move with it.

lines.zh: 别挡在我和伤口中间。
lines.en: Do not stand between me and the wound.

lines.zh: 骨头要先归位，光才能接上。
lines.en: The bone must set before the light can join it.

lines.zh: 我手心发烫，这是用力过度的信号。
lines.en: My palms burn; that means I am overdoing it.

lines.zh: 再给我一会儿，就快好了。
lines.en: Give me a moment more; it is nearly done.

lines.zh: 光散开的时候，你会觉得痒。
lines.en: When the light spreads, you will feel an itch.

lines.zh: 我把光拧成一股，对着裂口。
lines.en: I twist my light into a thread aimed at the tear.

lines.zh: 我一头撞过去，像被蜂蜇了一下。
lines.en: I ram you, like a single bee sting.

lines.zh: 我没有爪，只能用光烫你。
lines.en: I have no claws; I can only scorch you with light.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我的力气只够推一下。
lines.en: Do not push me; I can barely shove once.

lines.zh: 我把光压成一点，扎在你手背。
lines.en: I squeeze my light to a point and prick your hand.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，我只是想让你退开。
lines.en: That was light; I only wanted you to step back.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇你的脸，这是我最凶的样子。
lines.en: My wings slap your face; this is me at my fiercest.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，但我不会先跑。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I will not flee first.

lines.zh: 火花溅在你袖口，烧出一个小洞。
lines.en: Sparks hit your sleeve and burn a small hole.

lines.zh: 你伤到我了，我还手也只是亮一下。
lines.en: You hurt me; my answer is only a flash.

lines.zh: 我冲你眼睛去，那是最软的地方。
lines.en: I go for your eyes, the softest place.

lines.zh: 有人敲开一只蛋，我就这样出现了。
lines.en: Someone cracked an egg, and here I am.

lines.zh: 野外找不到我，我只从手里来。
lines.en: You will not find me in the wild; I come from a hand.

lines.zh: 我没有生成配置，世界不认得我。
lines.en: I have no spawn entry; the world does not know me.

lines.zh: 我落地时先亮了一下，像在打招呼。
lines.en: I flashed once on landing, like a greeting.

lines.zh: 蛋壳还在你脚边，我却已经会飞。
lines.en: The shell is still at your feet, and I can already fly.

lines.zh: 我说不清自己从哪里来，只有一只蛋。
lines.en: I cannot say where I came from; only an egg.

lines.zh: 你放我出来，我就跟着你走。
lines.en: You let me out, so I follow you.

lines.zh: 这个世界没有给我准备巢穴。
lines.en: This world prepared no nest for me.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见天，先眨了眨眼。
lines.en: The first time I saw the sky, I blinked.

lines.zh: 我没有掉落表，死掉也不会留下什么。
lines.en: I have no loot table; dying leaves nothing behind.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一响，我就欠你一条命。
lines.en: One spawn egg, and I owe you a life.

lines.zh: 别把我放在盒子里，我会闷。
lines.en: Do not keep me in a box; I would smother.

lines.zh: 我出来的地方有你的手掌味。
lines.en: Where I appeared still smells of your palm.

lines.zh: 我不是自然长出来的，是被想出来的。
lines.en: I was not grown but imagined into being.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到翅膀，焦味像糖。
lines.en: Flame licks my wing; the scorch smells like sugar.

lines.zh: 摔在石头上，我的光晃了好几下。
lines.en: I hit stone and my glow flickers several times.

lines.zh: 水灌进光里，我整个人暗了。
lines.en: Water floods my light and I go dark.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀出好远，翅膀全散。
lines.en: The blast throws me far, wings fully splayed.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个亮洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through, leaving a bright hole.

lines.zh: 那股魔法冷得让我不敢靠近。
lines.en: That magic is so cold I dare not come close.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿的其实是光。
lines.en: I do not eat; what starves is my light.

lines.zh: 雷落下来时，我以为我也碎了。
lines.en: When lightning struck, I thought I shattered too.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我的光被拉成一条线。
lines.en: Falling into the void, my light stretches to a thread.
